description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Purchasing product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: PO View Document).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Purchasing.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Purchasing accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 6.5 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).
